lines: The instructions were simple:
open the box, remove the protective sheet,
and place the panel on a flat surface.
There was one warning—keep the cable dry.
We read it twice before starting,
because the workspace was close to a sink.
Everything else went smoothly;
the connectors fitted without extra pressure.
Once the indicator light turned green,
we recorded the result in the installation log.
